description.value: Chase River Liquor Store is a retail liquor outlet located in Nanaimo's Chase River area (unit 10 of a multi-unit property). As a licensed alcohol retailer, it stocks beer, wine, and spirits for off-premise consumption. It is a routine convenience stop rather than a destination hospitality venue for touring cyclists.

address.value: 1273 Island Highway #10, Nanaimo, BC V9R 6Z9, Canada
